description: This Java test class validates Hibernate mappings against the generated database schema in the OpenMRS project. It manages database setup/teardown, processes Liquibase changelogs, and builds Hibernate SessionFactory instances to verify schema correctness.

classes.name: ValidateHibernateMappingsDatabaseIT
classes.description: JUnit test class extending DatabaseIT, used to validate Hibernate mappings for the OpenMRS database schema.

methods.name: shouldValidateHibernateMappings
methods.description: Main test method that drops the database, processes Liquibase changelogs, builds Hibernate session factory to validate mappings, and repeats for all changelog combinations.

methods.name: buildSessionFactory
methods.description: Constructs a Hibernate Configuration, registers entity classes, sets properties, and builds a SessionFactory to validate entity mappings against the schema.
